renderer: GitHub REST Markdown API, POST /markdown with mode=gfm
method: Render each complete unmodified response; decode HTML text with Python HTMLParser and compare complete quoted source/result inside strong elements, literal fenced output, and unwanted inline interpretations. A separate reviewer independently inspects the persisted HTML and exact string comparisons.
limitations: GFM rendering verification only; not intended-plugin-host rendering, clipboard behavior, activation, or a universal guarantee of model compliance.
